meta.name: to-questionnaire
meta.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊决策变成可填问卷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要别人帮你补充信息来做决定
copy.tagline_en: Turn unclear decisions into fillable questionnaires
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need others to provide information for your decisions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你描述收件人的角色和所需信息，然后自动生成一份 Markdown 问卷，供他人填写或会议使用。
howto.when: 当你需要向他人获取自己无法独立回答的决策信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份问卷，问同事关于新功能的技术方案。
say.note: Claude 会询问收件人角色和所需信息，然后生成问卷。

say.text: 我需要向客户了解他们对产品定价的期望。
say.note: Claude 会引导你明确收件人和需求，生成针对性问卷。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask you about the recipient's role and what you need, then generate a Markdown questionnaire for someone else to fill in or use in a meeting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to get information from someone else to make a decision you can't answer alone.

say_en.text: Create a questionnaire to ask a colleague about the technical plan for a new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about the recipient and needs, then generate the questionnaire.

say_en.text: I need to ask a client about their expectations for product pricing.
